# vcraft 1.4.2

A patch release: two code-generation fixes found in 1.4.1.

## Fixed

- **A method's signature is resolved by its receiver, not by its name.** Two structs that
  declared a method with the same name made the exported one take the first declaration's
  parameters — its trampoline and `.pyi` used the wrong signature, and the build failed
  with `cannot use int as Color` when the types differed. A free function and a method
  sharing a name are kept apart too.
- **A field is looked up inside its own struct.** Two structs with a field of the same name
  made the second read the first one's source line, so its `@[vc_field]` was missed and the
  field silently disappeared from the instance and the stub.
- **Enum members in the `.pyi` are typed as the enum** (`red: Color`, not `red: int`), so
  `Color.red` satisfies a `Color` parameter for a type checker.

## Upgrade

```console
$ pip install --upgrade vcraft
```

No migration needed. Full list in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rroblf01/vcraft/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#142---2026-10-16).
